ar.title: فراخ معصجة
ar.intro: يمكن استخدام الفراخ المعصجة في العديد من الأطباق مثل الجلاش، السامبوسك، الرقيقة، الفطاير، الطاجن المكرونة وغيرها. حفظها في الفريزر يوفر وقتًا ومجهودًا عند تحضير الوجبات.

steps.n5: أضيفي قطع الفراخ وقلبيها حتى تأخذ اللون من الجانبين.
steps.n6: أضيفي شرائح البصل وقلبيها مع الفراخ.

en.title: Sautéed Seasoned Chicken (Ma'saga)
en.intro: Use the seasoned chicken in many dishes like goulash, sambousek, ruqaq, pies, and pasta tagine. Keeping it in the freezer saves time and effort when preparing meals.

steps.n1: Wash the chicken breasts and drain them well.
steps.n2: Cut the onions into thin slices.
steps.n3: Cut the bell peppers into thin, small slices.
steps.n4: In a tray, place two spoons of ghee and a little oil and let it heat.
steps.n5: Add the chicken pieces and turn them until they take color on both sides.
steps.n6: Add the onion slices and toss with the chicken.
steps.n7: Add the salt, pepper, pinch of sugar, pinch of cinnamon, and a teaspoon of thyme.
steps.n8: Toss the ingredients well until the onion wilts.
steps.n9: Add the bell peppers and toss quickly a few times only.
steps.n10: Turn off the heat and let the chicken cool.
steps.n11: Place the chicken in freezer bags and store it in the freezer.
